findings.description: derive-descriptors: three of wp-contracts' five verification gates use bare `python3` with `import jsonschema` / `import yaml`, so they cannot pass regardless of correct schema and contract work. Executed from the repo root as written: Gate "CLI contract schema is valid JSON Schema" → `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'jsonschema'` (exit 1); Gate "gen-eval CLI contract exists and validates against the schema" → `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml'` (exit 1); Gate "Contract instances validate against the PROMOTED schema" → same `yaml` failure (exit 1). `which python3` → `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3`. The same package's pytest gate already uses `uv run` with `cwd: packages/gen-eval`, and `uv run --directory packages/gen-eval python -c "import jsonschema,yaml"` succeeds — jsonschema is a gen-eval dev dependency and pyyaml a runtime dependency. Gate "Promoted CLI contract schema is byte-identical" is unaffected (stdlib only). This is the residual of the round-4 interpreter class of bug: B's gen_eval gates and A's regenerate/`McpToolSpec` probe were switched to `uv run python`, but these three file validators were not. Until fixed, wp-contracts verification is red on a correct tree whenever the ambient `python3` is not a pre-provisioned venv.
